summary: The big plan from the address is cut from the budget after suburbs and legislators object.
realLife: A governor made housing a top aim in her address and offered a plan with construction targets for every locality and a state power to override local zoning. Suburban officials and lawmakers refused, the plan was removed from a budget that was weeks late, and the governor said the effort was not over, with leaders promising a new housing plan before the session ended.
sources: WAMC (Albany, New York), via WXXI News, 'Channeling Wayne Gretzky, Hochul says: At least I took the shot on failed housing plan', April 26, 2023: https://www.wamc.org/2023-04-26/channeling-wayne-gretzky-hochul-says-at-least-i-took-the-shot-on-failed-housing-plan
